notes.title: Good News everybody! (New Patch!)
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to the BlobCat ptach notes!

This patch does not include that many new things BUT everything is now more shiny!... Means polished!

- Added golden mice! Worth 10 points!
- BIG perfomance update! Even your toaster can now run this game!
- Added countdown soundeffects
- We cut the file size of the game in half without cutting content!
- Smooth transitions for the retro and lights off event
- Sped up and down music for the speed up and down event
- Music now fades out with every scene transition
- The game preloads many assets to avoid loading hicups
- New match settings window
- Loading screens for the multiplayer and no more disconnects when loading takes too long!
- Settings will now also be stored in the cloud
- And a lot of other little things!

We're now working on one last big content patch, adding achievements and a ingame shop to buy more clothing for your mice avatar (INGAME CURRENCY ONLY, NO MICROTRANSACTIONS!). After that we'll see how well BlobCat will do on consoles. If we can sell more than, like, 10 copies we'll consider adding more clothing and multiplayer levels!

Thanks for reading!
Blob on!

notes.title: Pictures, French and more! A new Patch is here!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Thanks again for the support! We hope to attract some more players over the coming week so we can finance upcoming and free content!

First: Thanks to the guys from NativeTranslations (https://nativetranslationsfr.wordpress.com/) you can now enjoy the game in french! Yay!

You wanted more to unlock so you got more! Get 120 stars to unlock the artbook with 13 pictures of artworks and prototype images. We'll add more if we find more.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fSEi4Tb.png[/img]

Also.. there seems to be a new world coming up!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/X1LTQIS.png[/img]

Also also in this version are some fixes!
- Fixed an case where you could place arrows outside of bounds
- Fixed the cursor, that could get stucked on a signpole
- Some UI fixes

More to come!
Have a great day!

notes.title: Day 3 Patch
notes.notes:
HELLOOOO!!!
This should be the last daily patch so hopefully everything works now as expected! And also: we got a new hat!!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ieYdemx.jpg[/img]

[b]Singleplayer[/b]
- Broke the controller support! Sorry! Works again!
- Sticker list can now be scrolled with the mouse wheel
- The music will be normal, when you're done with the tutorial
- Also, you can't mess with the tutorial using a controller anymore

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
- New hat: Jelly
- Fixed the music for the retro event and forest levels
- Fixed the amount slider updating correctly
- Fixed the display of the current mode for all clients in the room

We also would like to remind everyone to write a Steam review, that helps ALOT!
Thanks everybody!
Blob on!

notes.title: Day 2 Patch
notes.notes:
Hi all!
Don't worry, we won't put out a patch everyday, but there are some things we have to adress.

[b]General[/b]
- We boosted the collision calculation to get rid of some stucked cats and mice. This COULD mean, that some levels are broken. We will test every level over the weekend, to make sure that the game is beatable. This also means, that the game is a bit more stressful on the CPU. Sorry potatoe pcs :/

[b]Singleplayer[/b]
- Fixed the lighting of some snow levels.

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
- Fixed the music for the retro event. The transition from current to retro track will now be seamless
- Fixed the range the cursor could reach in kitchenMP3

[b]Upcoming after the next fixes[/b]
- Steam cloud, trading cards and achievement support
- New clothing for the multiplayer
- Unlocking some features for collecting stars in the singleplayer
- Spelling errors will be fixed #placeing

notes.title: Launch Day Patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Thank you so much for purchasing this game!
It's our plan to support this game over a long period of time, so every sold copy helps us to do this!
Since we are only three people there will always be little hicups here and there, but it's our goal to get them all!

The patch today fixes the following:

[u]Multiplayer[/u]
- Sticky arrows for clients are gone!
- Some controller and UI related fixes

[u]Singleplayer[/u]
- Sometimes, when a cat or a mice touches the mouse whole and the player presses "stop" the character will be stuck till you reload the level, this should be fixed.
- Replaced the music with newer versions of each track

[u]General[/u]
- There is now a "Quit" button on the title screen

This is all for today!
We have plans for at least one more world for the singleplayer and three new levels for the multiplayer. Stay tuned!
